en: Black‑and‑white view of a historic European town dominated by massive stone fortifications. In the foreground stands a round medieval watchtower with a crenellated crown and conical roof elements beside portions of a city wall. Behind it rises a large Gothic church or former castle-like complex with steep tiled roofs and narrow pointed spires. Farther back, densely packed townhouses with steep gabled roofs fill the hillside, and a tall, slender church tower with a baroque-style spire punctuates the skyline. Vegetation and fields occupy the immediate foreground. There is no visible printed or handwritten text on the image side.
